notes: All five named tests are in package deploy in the new internal/deploy/domain_owner_test.go, and the diff changes no existing test line. They use testEngine, testProject, temp dirs and a per-run unix admin socket, and they skip only when no Engine answers outside CI. TestSwitchReleaseRejectsDomainRoutedByAnotherApp requires both deploys of x.example to succeed, A's switch SUCCEEDED, B's switch REJECTED with the exact detail, an unchanged POST /load count, B's stored and result state still the ready candidate with no current, the row still candidate, the container still running, and the last document routing x.example only to A's release. Both rollback tests require the exact detail, no POST /load, current r2 and previous r1, and the previous container still present; the stopped case compares every apps and releases row to a snapshot taken after ContainerStop and checks that the container still exists. TestSwitchReleaseKeepsOwnDomains requires SUCCEEDED and pushed routes for A's r2 on x.example and z2.example and B's r1 on z.example in app_id order, with dials taken from the containers. TestProxyPushRoutedRejectsDomainBeforePosting requires the exact error text, errors.As of rejectedError, commit not called, no POST /load, and the same last document, on a routed release with no container so a check after route building cannot pass. testdata/tests.txt does not list these tests yet.
